2:38.text: We said, "Go down from it, all of you. And when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

2:39.text: And those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those will be companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally."

2:40.text: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and fulfill My covenant
that I will fulfill your covenant

2:41.text: And believe in what I have sent down confirming that which is
with you, and be not the first to disbelieve in it. And do not exchange My signs for a small price, and fear

2:42.text: And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know

2:43.text: And establish prayer and give zakāh
and bow with those who bow

2:44.text: Do you order righteousness of the people and forget
yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason?

2:45.text: And seek help through patience and prayer; and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive

2:46.text: Who are certain that they will meet their Lord and that they will return to Him.

2:47.text: O Children of Israel, remember My favor that I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds

2:48.text: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul
at all, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be taken from it, nor will they be aided.
